entries.title: Cronos: The New Dawn

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC presentation with scalable settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC Deluxe Edition is the best current route because it combines the full game with the listed Deluxe bonuses and PC capture/settings flexibility. The announced Lazarus DLC is still a future update, so this entry should be revisited after that DLC releases.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Cronos: The New Dawn Deluxe Edition on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Recheck the entry after the announced Lazarus DLC releases.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original release. Lazarus DLC is announced for Fall 2026 and is not treated as released content in this entry.
